### Recognizing God’s Guidance
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/recognizing-gods-guidance-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Acts 16:7-10
Points:
- Paul demonstrated spiritual maturity by promptly abandoning his own travel plans when the Spirit closed doors.
- Instead of becoming discouraged or paralyzed by indecision, Paul kept moving forward and trusting God to guide his steps.
- God's nos often serve to redirect believers toward His greater purposes and best outcomes.
- Discerning God's guidance requires surrendering selfish ambition and personal agendas.
- Asking God daily to align our desires with His will brings clarity, peace, and spiritual sensitivity.

### When Life Doesn't Go Your Way
Author: Dr. Roger Barrier
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/when-life-doesn-t-go-your-way-bible-study-minute-january-1-2019.html
Passage: Acts 16:7-9
Points:
- Every Christian faces closed doors and disrupted expectations at various points in life.
- Paul wanted to minister in Bithynia, but God redirected him across the sea to Macedonia.
- God can accomplish world-changing work through the leftovers of broken human plans.
- True faith means trusting that God still has a purposeful plan even when life feels like second best.
